title: Single-hop model fallback on eligible provider errors

test_cases.name: Fallback eligibility criteria verification
test_cases.evidence: Eligibility classification adheres strictly to trigger rules

test_cases.name: Primary success bypasses fallback invocation
test_cases.input_setup: Execute run_with_single_fallback with succeeding primary callable
test_cases.expected_result: Fallback not called; meta indicates fallback_used=False
test_cases.evidence: Primary call succeeded without invoking fallback

test_cases.name: Eligible error triggers single fallback call
test_cases.expected_result: Fallback executed; meta records fallback_used=True and served_deployment
test_cases.evidence: Eligible 503 triggered exactly one fallback hop

test_cases.name: Ineligible error propagated without invoking fallback
test_cases.evidence: 400 error re-raised immediately; fallback never called

test_cases.name: Fallback failure propagated without infinite looping
test_cases.input_setup: Both primary and fallback raise exceptions
test_cases.expected_result: Fallback exception propagated cleanly; maximum single hop enforced
test_cases.evidence: Fallback exception propagated without infinite loop
